v2-fusion-cars-bastion-v1.note: Broad soot/rust fortress, corner teeth and right-facing cannon; four heavy tyre masses. Roof-plan read and large armour blocks clearly exceed v1. Pixel gates pass; owner taste remains pending.

v2-fusion-cars-needle-v1.note: Narrow open tubular chassis with exposed rear engine and forked right nose. Large transparent gaps and four thin tread tops separate it strongly from Bastion at 96px. No stretching applied.

v2-fusion-cars-line-v1.note: Corrected roof plan removes prior circular wheel side faces. Low red coupe body, chipped off-centre ivory stripe and squared welded repairs. Pixel gates pass.

v2-fusion-cars-comet-v1.note: Third source keeps overhead roof/tyre tops but a very wide rear wing makes aspect 1.64 versus C1 2.57, and right source margin is 22px. Rejected at the three-attempt cap. Prior attempts remain in evidence; not an approved reference.

v2-fusion-cars-trail-v1.note: Second source is a true roof plan with tread rectangles; first side-facing hatchback rejected. Squat ochre hatch, roof braces and compact broad stance distinguish the grip archetype.

v2-fusion-cars-flint-v1.note: Third source has complete margins, squat ram-pickup roof and open rear-bed shape. There is a pale structural bed panel, not the first attempt loose bone. Strong blunt rightward ram; pixel gates pass.

v2-fusion-cars-quill-v1.note: Third source now has a long skeletal chassis and transparent interior, but long forward tips leave only 16px at the right edge. Reject despite readable 96px light silhouette. Three-call ceiling reached; no further spend.

v2-fusion-cars-vandal-v1.note: Second source removes side-looking wheel hubs; red interceptor roof plan with chipped diagonal ivory shoulder patches, sharp ram and short tail fins. Broad hard body contrasts with light frames.

v2-fusion-cars-kestrel-v1.note: Long spear silhouette and small rear fins read at 96px, but the right tip leaves 24px margin. Rejected at the three-attempt ceiling. No padding or stretch used to pass.

v2-fusion-cars-bulwark-v1.note: Six rectangular tyre treads, broad three-rib roof, paired short mounts and full-width ram. Dense solid mass strongly contrasts with Needle; source aspect and margins pass.

v2-fusion-portraits-rook-v1.note: Complete gaunt bust, broken goggles, bitter face and one large jagged shoulder plate; torn costume and harsh soot values. Small triangular warning pictograms retained as wordless details.

v2-fusion-portraits-ox-v1.note: Wide slab shoulders and square silver-haired head form the heavy-hauler silhouette. Original portrait traits retained; gender is not inferred from appearance or a model vote.

v2-fusion-portraits-vex-v1.note: Corrected complete bust: tall wild swept crest, narrow pointed shoulders, scarf and toothy restless expression. Strongly distinct from broad Ox and reserved Marrow.

v2-fusion-portraits-mica-v1.note: Compact balanced dark-skinned portrait, coiled hair/head wrap, ear protector and short cheek marks; steady expression and broken jacket hems.

v2-fusion-portraits-relay-v1.note: Slanted haircut, repaired ear defenders, one triangular shoulder fin and red/bone jacket create the asymmetrical radio-runner silhouette. No readable lettering.

v2-fusion-portraits-marrow-v1.note: Corrected complete older face, tall black collar and broad layered shoulder mantle. Severe silver crest and restrained expression distinguish the boss without a copied costume.
